title: StoreInput
description:
A data file: any combination of the sections below. Every `*.json` file at the root of the
data directory is one of these, and they are merged, so you can split the data as you like
(`shop.json`, `catalog.json`, ...).

$schema.description: Lets editors validate and autocomplete the file, e.g. `"./schema/store.schema.json"`.

shop.description: General store information. At most one data file may define it.

products.description: Products. They can also live one per file in `products/`.

collections.description: Collections. They can also live one per file in `collections/`.

pages.description: Pages. They can also live one per file in `pages/`.

blogs.description: Blogs with their articles. They can also live one per file in `blogs/`.

menus.description: Navigation menus by handle, e.g. `main-menu` and `footer`.

customers.description: Customers. They can also live one per file in `customers/`.

companies.description: Companies that buy from the store (B2B). Customers join one with their `company`.

gift_cards.description: Issued gift cards, each with its own page.

localization.description: The countries and languages of the store. At most one data file may define it.

swatches.description:
The swatches of product option values, by the name of the value:
`{"White": "#ffffff", "Floral": {"image": "swatches/floral.jpg"}}`. Every option value
with one of these names gets the swatch, on products and in collection filters.

locations.description: The places the store stocks products at, for store pickup.

selling_plan_groups.description: Groups of selling plans: subscriptions, pre-orders and other purchase options.

files.description: Metadata for files in `files/`, by path.

session.description: What every new browser session starts with: a logged-in customer, a filled cart...

checkout.description:
The fake checkout of `lsf app dev --app`: shipping rates, payment methods, discounts
and Function settings. At most one data file may define it.

now.description:
Freezes the clock: the instant `'now'` resolves to, e.g. `"2025-01-15T10:00:00Z"`.
Set it to make renders reproducible; each `'now'` of a render is then one nanosecond
after the previous one, so `%N` still differs between calls. Defaults to the real time,
read at each `'now'`.

theme_settings.description: Overrides for theme settings (`config/settings_data.json`), by setting id.

ShopInput.description: General store information (the `shop` object). Every field has a sensible default.

domain.description: The primary domain, without scheme. Defaults to the host the server is reached on.

permanent_domain.description: The `*.myshopify.com` domain. Defaults to a value derived from the name.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the store currency. Defaults to `USD`.

money_format.description:
How `money` formats amounts, e.g. `"${{amount}}"` or `"{{amount_with_comma_separator}} €"`.
Defaults to the usual format of the currency.

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to display dates, e.g. `"Europe/Paris"`. Defaults to `UTC`.

customer_accounts_enabled.description: Whether customer accounts exist at all. Defaults to `true`.

customer_accounts_optional.description: Whether checking out as a guest is possible. Defaults to `true`.

taxes_included.description: Whether prices include taxes. Defaults to `false`.

password_message.description: The message shown on the password page.

password.description:
The password the `/password` page accepts. Defaults to `"password"`. The storefront is
never locked: the page is there to be worked on, and nothing leads to it.

AddressInput.description: A postal address. Every field is optional.

PoliciesInput.description: The store policies. Each one that is set gets a page under `/policies/`.

title.description: Defaults to the standard title of the policy.

BrandInput.description: The brand assets of the store (`shop.brand`).

colors.description: Brand colors as CSS hex strings, e.g. `{"primary": ["#112233"], "secondary": []}`.

ImageInput.description:
An image: either just its source, or an object with more detail.

The source is a path inside the `files/` directory of the data directory
(`"shirt.jpg"` → `files/shirt.jpg`). When no such file exists a placeholder of the declared
size is generated, so fixtures work without shipping real images.

src.description: Path of the image inside `files/`, e.g. `"products/shirt-front.jpg"`.

alt.description: Alternative text. Defaults to an empty string.

width.description: Width in pixels. Read from the file when it exists, otherwise defaults to 1200.

height.description: Height in pixels. Read from the file when it exists, otherwise defaults to 1200.

focal_point.description: The focal point as percentages from the top-left corner, e.g. `{"x": 50, "y": 20}`.

FocalPoint.description: The point of an image that should stay visible when it is cropped.

MetafieldInput.description:
A metafield value. Write the value directly and its type is inferred (string →
`single_line_text_field`, integer → `number_integer`, decimal → `number_decimal`, boolean →
`boolean`, anything else → `json`), or spell out `{"type": ..., "value": ...}`.

TypedMetafield.description: A metafield with an explicit type.

type.description:
A Shopify metafield type, e.g. `single_line_text_field`, `multi_line_text_field`,
`rich_text_field`, `number_integer`, `number_decimal`, `boolean`, `color`, `date`,
`date_time`, `url`, `json`, `money`, `rating`, `weight`, `volume`, `dimension` and the
other measurements (`distance`, `temperature`, `duration`...), `product_reference`,
`collection_reference`, `page_reference`, `article_reference` (`blog/article`, or the
article's handle alone), `file_reference`, `metaobject_reference`, or a `list.` variant
of those.

value.description:
The value. References are written as handles (`"blue-shirt"`), files as paths inside
`files/`, lists as JSON arrays.

ProductInput.description:
A product.

The smallest valid product is `{"title": "Blue shirt", "price": 1999}`: it gets a single
default variant, like a product without options in the Shopify admin.

$schema.description: Lets editors validate and autocomplete the file, e.g. `"../schema/product.schema.json"`.

id.description: Generated from the handle when omitted.

handle.description:
The URL slug (`/products/<handle>`). Derived from the title when omitted. In a
`products/<name>.json` file it defaults to the file name.

options.description:
Option names, e.g. `["Size", "Color"]`. At most three. Omit for a product with a
single default variant.

variants.description: The variants. Each must give one value per option.

price.description: Price of the variants that do not set their own, and of the default variant.

compare_at_price.description: Compare-at price of the variants that do not set their own.

images.description: Shorthand for image-only media. Use `media` for videos and 3D models.

media.description: Images, videos and models in display order. When set, `images` must be empty.

available.description: Shorthand to set availability on every variant that does not say otherwise.

collections.description:
Handles of the collections this product belongs to, in addition to the collections
that list it in their own `products`.

gift_card.description: Whether the product is a gift card (`product.gift_card?`).

recommendations.description:
Handles of the products returned by product recommendations for this product.
Defaults to other products from the same collections.

selling_plan_groups.description:
Names of the selling plan groups (from `selling_plan_groups`) this product is sold
with, in addition to the groups that list it in their own `products`.

requires_selling_plan.description:
Whether the product can only be bought with a selling plan, like a product sold by
subscription only. Defaults to `false`.

OptionInput.description: A product option. Write just the name (`"Size"`); the values are collected from the variants.

OptionDetail.description: A product option with its values in a chosen order.

values.description:
The values in display order. Defaults to the order they appear in the variants. A
value is its name (`"White"`), or its name with a swatch
(`{"name": "White", "swatch": "#ffffff"}`).

OptionValueInput.description: A value of a product option: its name, or its name with a swatch.

OptionValueDetail.description: A value of a product option with its swatch (`product_option_value.swatch`).

swatch.description:
The swatch of the value on this product. Defaults to the swatch the store's
`swatches` give to this name.

SwatchInput.description:
How an option value is shown instead of its name: a CSS color (`"#f4f1ea"`), or an object
with a color, an image, or both.

SwatchDetail.description: A swatch with a color, an image, or both (`swatch.color`, `swatch.image`).

image.description: An image, for a pattern that a single color cannot show.

id.description: Generated from the product handle and the variant's position when omitted.

title.description: Defaults to the option values joined with ` / ` (`"Small / Blue"`).

options.description: One value per product option, in the order of the product's `options`.

compare_at_price.description: The price before a sale. Must be higher than `price` to show as a discount.

sku.description: Also a convenient way to reference the variant from carts and orders.

available.description: Whether the variant can be bought. Derived from the inventory fields when omitted.

inventory_quantity.description: Units in stock. Setting it turns inventory tracking on.

inventory_tracked.description:
Set to `false` to disable inventory tracking (the variant is then always available).
Defaults to `true` when `inventory_quantity` is set, `false` otherwise.

weight_unit.description: The unit the weight is displayed in: `g`, `kg`, `oz` or `lb`. Defaults to `kg`.

image.description: The `src` of the product image that shows this variant.

store_availabilities.description:
The locations (from `locations`, by name) that stock this variant, and whether it is in
stock there: `{"Portland": true, "Seattle": false}`. When omitted, every location stocks
the variant, and it is in stock there when the variant is available.

Money.description: An amount of money: an integer number of cents (`1999`, the unit Liquid uses) or a decimal string in the shop currency (`"19.99"`). Floats such as `19.99` are rejected because they are ambiguous.

InventoryPolicy.description: What happens when a tracked variant is out of stock.

oneOf.description: Stop selling when the stock reaches zero.
Keep selling when out of stock.

UnitPriceMeasurement.description: What a unit price refers to, e.g. 250 g priced per 100 g.

QuantityRule.description: The quantities a variant can be bought in (`variant.quantity_rule`).

max.description: Maximum quantity. No maximum when omitted.

increment.description: Quantities must be a multiple of this. Defaults to 1.

QuantityPriceBreak.description: A volume price: the unit price from a given quantity.

MediaInput.description: A piece of product media. Images can be written as a plain string.

MediaDetail.description: A video, an external (YouTube/Vimeo) video or a 3D model.

preview_image.description: The image shown before the media plays.

sources.description: `video` and `model`: the files, by decreasing preference.

external_id.description: `external_video`: the id of the video on the host, e.g. `dQw4w9WgXcQ`.

aspect_ratio.description: Width divided by height. Defaults to the preview image's ratio, or 16:9.

MediaType.description: The kind of a piece of media that is not an image.

MediaSource.description: One file of a video or 3D model.

url.description: Path inside `files/` or an absolute URL.

VideoHost.description: Where an external video is hosted.

CollectionInput.description:
A collection of products.

A collection named `all` containing every product always exists; define it yourself only
to change its title or order.

$schema.description: Lets editors validate and autocomplete the file, e.g. `"../schema/collection.schema.json"`.

products.description: Handles of the products in the collection, in manual order.

rules.description:
Makes the collection automated: products matching the rules are added after the ones
listed in `products`.

disjunctive.description: With several rules: `true` to match any of them, `false` (default) to match all.

sort_order.description: The default order of the products. Defaults to `manual`.

CollectionRule.description: A rule of an automated collection: products matching it are included.

condition.description: The value compared with, e.g. `"sale"` for a tag or `"5000"` for a price in cents.

RuleColumn.description: The product property an automated collection rule looks at.

RuleRelation.description: How an automated collection rule compares the property to its condition.

SortOrder.description: How a collection orders its products by default.

$schema.description: Lets editors validate and autocomplete the file, e.g. `"../schema/page.schema.json"`.
Lets editors validate and autocomplete the file, e.g. `"../schema/blog.schema.json"`.

articles.description: Articles, newest first unless they carry `published_at` dates.

comments_enabled.description: Whether readers can comment. Defaults to `false`.

moderated.description: Whether comments wait for approval. Defaults to `false`.

excerpt.description: HTML excerpt. `article.excerpt_or_content` falls back to the content.

$schema.description: Lets editors validate and autocomplete the file, e.g. `"../schema/menu.schema.json"`.

LinkInput.description:
A link in a navigation menu.

Point it at a resource with exactly one of `url`, `collection`, `product`, `page`, `blog`,
`article` or `policy`; the URL and the link type follow from it. A link with none of them
points to `#`.

links.description: Nested links (up to three levels, like the Shopify admin).

CustomerInput.description:
A customer. Sessions log in as a customer by email (see `session.customer`), and the checkout
of an app lists the customers as login profiles: "Log in" logs the checkout in as one of them,
with their addresses (the first is the default) and, for a B2B customer, their locations.

$schema.description: Lets editors validate and autocomplete the file, e.g. `"../schema/customer.schema.json"`.

addresses.description: The first address is the default one (`customer.default_address`).

company.description: The name of a company in `companies`: the customer buys for it (B2B).

company_locations.description:
The names of the locations of the company the customer can buy for. Defaults to all
of them.

company_contact.description:
What the company knows of the customer as a buyer: their job title, language, dates.
Checkout Functions read it as `purchasingCompany.contact`.

OrderInput.description: An order of a customer, shown on account pages.

name.description: The order name, e.g. `"#1001"`. Generated when omitted.

returns.description: What the customer sent back, as the customer account shows it.

variant.description: A variant, by id or SKU, or a product handle (its first variant is used).

VariantRef.description:
A reference to a variant: its numeric id, its SKU, or a product handle (meaning that
product's first variant).

line_items.description:
The lines sent back, by their variant, and how many of each. Defaults to every line of
the order.

CompanyContactInput.description:
A customer as a contact of their company (B2B): `purchasingCompany.contact` of a checkout
Function.

title.description: The job title of the contact, e.g. `"Purchasing manager"`.

locale.description: The language of the contact, e.g. `"fr"`. None when absent.

created_at.description: Defaults to the creation date of the company.

CompanyInput.description:
A company that buys from the store (B2B). A customer whose `company` names it is a B2B
customer: `customer.b2b?` is true, and `customer.current_company` is this company.

name.description: The name customers refer to the company by.

external_id.description: The id the merchant gives the company in its own systems.

locations.description: The places the company buys for. The first one is selected when a customer logs in.

created_at.description: Defaults to a fixed date, 2024-01-01 plus one day per company.

CompanyLocationInput.description: A place a company buys for (`customer.current_location`): a branch, a shop, a warehouse.

external_id.description: The id the merchant gives the location in its own systems.

shipping_address.description: Where orders of this location ship to.

tax_registration_id.description: The tax number of the location, e.g. a VAT number.

locale.description: The preferred language of the location, e.g. `"fr"`. None when absent.

created_at.description: Defaults to the creation date of the company.

orders_count.description:
The number of orders placed at the location, which checkout Functions read as
`ordersCount`. The orders of the customers are not counted: defaults to 0.

total_spent.description: The amount spent at the location (`totalSpent`), e.g. `"1250.00"`. Defaults to 0.

GiftCardInput.description:
An issued gift card, shown by `templates/gift_card.liquid` at the URL the `routes` command lists
(`/gift_cards/<shop id>/<token>`).

code.description: The code customers redeem at checkout, e.g. `"WCGX7X97G74JGDGC"`.

initial_value.description: The value the card was issued with.

balance.description: What is left on the card. Defaults to `initial_value`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Defaults to the shop's currency.

expires_on.description:
The day the card stops working, e.g. `"2026-12-31"`. A date before `now` makes the card
`expired`.

enabled.description: `false` for a card the merchant disabled.

customer.description: The email of the customer (from `customers`) the card belongs to.

send_on.description: When the card is scheduled to be sent to its recipient.

product.description: The handle of the gift card product that was bought.

properties.description: Line item properties of the purchase.

GiftCardRecipientInput.description: Who a gift card was sent to.

fields.description: Field values, with the same shorthand as metafields.

template_suffix.description:
Selects `templates/metaobject/<type>.<suffix>.json` instead of
`templates/metaobject/<type>.json` for the page of the entry, which is
`/pages/<type>/<handle>`.

LocalizationInput.description:
The countries and languages the store sells in (the `localization` object).

The first language is the primary one and is served at `/`; the others are served under
`/<iso_code>/`. Defaults to one country (`US`) and the theme's default language.

markets.description:
Groups of countries sold as one market. A country in none of them is a market of its
own, named after the country.

CountryInput.description: A country the store sells to.

name.description: Defaults to the English name of the country.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Defaults to the store currency.

popular.description: Whether to list the country among the popular ones.

LanguageInput.description: A language the store is published in.

name.description: The language's name in English. Defaults to a built-in name.

endonym_name.description: The language's name in that language. Defaults to a built-in name.

MarketInput.description:
A market: the countries the store sells to as one, as checkout Functions see it in
`localization.market` and `MailingAddress.market`.

countries.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of its countries, which are in `localization.countries`.

LocationInput.description:
A place the store stocks products at, where customers can pick up their orders
(`variant.store_availabilities`, `store_availability.location`).

name.description: The name of the location. Variants refer to it by this name.

pick_up_enabled.description: Whether orders can be picked up at the location. Defaults to `true`.

pick_up_time.description: How long a pickup order takes to be ready. Defaults to `"Usually ready in 24 hours"`.

physical_storefront.description: Whether the location is a shop that sells in person. Defaults to `true`.

SellingPlanGroupInput.description:
A group of selling plans (`product.selling_plan_groups`): what a subscription app creates
for "Subscribe and save". Products are sold with a group when the group lists them in
`products`, or when they name the group in their own `selling_plan_groups`.

name.description:
The name shown to customers, e.g. `"Subscribe and save"`. Products refer to the group
by this name.

app_id.description: The id of the app that created the group (`selling_plan_group.app_id`).

options.description:
The names of the options the plans differ by. Defaults to one option,
`"Delivery frequency"`.

selling_plans.description: The plans of the group. At least one.

products.description: Handles of the products sold with these plans.

SellingPlanInput.description: A selling plan: one way of buying a product, such as "Deliver every month, 10% off".

id.description: Generated from the names of the group and of the plan when omitted.

name.description: The name shown to customers, e.g. `"Deliver every month, 10% off"`.

options.description: One value per option of the group, e.g. `["Every month"]`. Defaults to the plan's name.

price_adjustments.description:
How the plan changes the price: at most two adjustments, the first one applies to the
first orders. No adjustment means the price of the variant.

recurring_deliveries.description: Whether the plan delivers more than once. Defaults to `true`.

checkout_charge.description: What is paid at checkout. Defaults to the whole price (`percentage`, `100`).

PriceAdjustmentInput.description: A price adjustment of a selling plan (`selling_plan.price_adjustments`).

value.description:
With `percentage`: the percentage, e.g. `10`. With `fixed_amount` and `price`: an
amount of money, e.g. `"2.00"` or `200`.

order_count.description: The number of orders the adjustment applies to. Every order when omitted.

AdjustmentType.description: How a price adjustment of a selling plan changes the price.

oneOf.description: `value` percent off the price of the variant.
`value` (an amount of money) off the price of the variant.
`value` (an amount of money) is the price.

CheckoutChargeInput.description: What is paid at checkout, for plans that take a deposit (`selling_plan.checkout_charge`).

value.description: With `percentage`: the percentage, e.g. `50`. With `price`: an amount of money.

CheckoutChargeType.description: How the amount due at checkout is expressed.

FileInput.description: A file in `files/` that needs metadata. Files without an entry work too.

width.description: Size to assume when the file itself is absent (a placeholder is generated).

SessionInput.description:
The state a browser session starts with. Tests can replace it per session through the
control API (`PUT /__lsf/session`).

$schema.description: Lets editors validate and autocomplete the file, e.g. `"../schema/session.schema.json"`.

customer.description:
Who is logged in: the email of a customer, `"default"` for the first customer of the
data, or `"none"`. Nobody is logged in when omitted.

cart.description: The content of the cart. Empty when omitted.

country.description: ISO code of the selected country. Defaults to the first country.

company_location.description:
For a B2B customer: the name of the company location they buy for. Defaults to the
first one they have access to.

CartInput.description: The cart a session starts with.

CartLineInput.description: A line of the cart a session starts with.

variant.description: A variant, by id or SKU, or a product handle (its first variant is used).

selling_plan.description:
The selling plan the line is bought with: its name or its id. The product of the
variant must be sold with it.

SellingPlanRef.description: A reference to a selling plan: its numeric id, or its name.

CheckoutInput.description: How the local checkout (`lsf app dev --app`) is set up. Every field has a default.

shipping_rates.description: The delivery options offered to every address. Defaults to one, "Standard" at 5.00.

payment_methods.description: The payment methods. Defaults to "Credit card", "Cash on Delivery" and "Bank Deposit".

discounts.description: Discounts backed by discount Functions of the app.

functions.description: The settings of the other Functions, by the handle of the Function.

tax_rate.description:
Tax in percent, added on top of the discounted subtotal: `20` for 20 %. No tax when
omitted.

CheckoutShippingRateInput.description: A delivery option the local checkout offers to every address.

handle.description: What Functions and the page call the option: `"standard"`.

title.description: What the buyer sees. Defaults to the handle.

CheckoutDeliveryKind.description: What kind of delivery a shipping rate is.

CheckoutPaymentMethodInput.description: A payment method the local checkout offers.

handle.description: What payment customization Functions and the page call the method: `"card"`.

name.description: What the buyer sees. Defaults to the handle.

placements.description:
Where the method is offered, which payment customization Functions read as
`placements`. Defaults to `["PAYMENT_METHOD"]`: the list of the checkout.

CheckoutPaymentPlacement.description: Where a payment method is offered.

oneOf.description: The list of payment methods of the checkout.
The express buttons (Shop Pay, Apple Pay, ...).

CheckoutDiscountInput.description: A discount backed by a discount Function of the app.

function.description: The handle of the discount Function in the app.

title.description: What the buyer sees. Defaults to the handle of the Function.

code.description: The code that triggers the discount. Without one the discount is automatic.

classes.description: What the discount may reduce. All three when omitted.

metafields.description:
The metafields of the discount, which its Function's input query reads, by
`"namespace.key"`: `{"$app:config.settings": {"type": "json", "value": {"percent": 10}}}`.

CheckoutFunctionInput.description:
The settings of a Function that is not a discount: cart transform, delivery or payment
customization, validation.

metafields.description: The metafields of the object the Function belongs to, by `"namespace.key"`.
